summary: Sandbach United is just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign with an exciting new-look squad featuring several fresh additions and a returning player. The Ramblers showed solid form in their recent friendly against St Helens, though they came up short against opponents who were clinical in front of goal. With three new kits ready to go and player details being released, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support what promises to be an exciting season ahead.
